bullets.title: The Gift: Poems by Hafiz, the Great Sufi Master
bullets.creator: Hafiz
bullets.note: fourhourmail.com/c/92unw45ooanh32805/opfkhq/aHR0cHM6Ly9lbi53aWtpcGVkaWEub3JnL3dpa2kvRGFuaWVsX0xhZGluc2t5)).** Speaking as someone who actively avoided poetry for decades, I have a confession: Hafiz has become one of my favorite writers in the last year. I randomly (or not?) found this collection at a bookstore and flipped to several poems that made me burst out laughing, including “[Two Giant Fat People](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/92unw45ooanh32805/zvtghn/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudGhlc3VubWFnYXppbmUub3JnL2lzc3Vlcy80NTQvcG9lbXMtYnktaGFmaXo=).” Hafiz is a profound joker, and his poems are unlike any poetry I’ve ever seen. Here is part of the description from Amazon: “Chosen by author Elizabeth Gilbert as one of her ten favorite books, Daniel Ladinsky’s extraordinary renderings of 250 unforgettable lyrical poems by Hafiz, one of the greatest Sufi poets of all time.” I also want to thank all of you who contributed to the social media discussion ([Facebook](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/92unw45ooanh32805/pnceh9/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmFjZWJvb2suY29tL1RpbUZlcnJpc3MvcG9zdHMvMTAxNTYzNTA2ODc4OTIyNDE=), [Twitter](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/92unw45ooanh32805/xksph6/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS90ZmVycmlzcy9zdGF0dXMvOTU0NDk2NjMyNzA3NjAwMzkw)) on Hafiz earlier this year. What a gem!

bullets.title: Aterciopelados
bullets.note:
([@aterciopelados](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/92unw45ooanh32805/q3i8h7/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9hdGVyY2lvcGVsYWRvcz9sYW5nPWVu)). One of my favorite songs: “[El Estuche](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/92unw45ooanh32805/gvfnh5/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g_dj1RbnUwTXd3NDl1cw==).”

**Gift I’m using —  
[3M Coban LF (latex-free) self-adhesive wrap](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/92unw45ooanh32805/93tzhn/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS8zTS1IZWFsdGgtQ2FyZS0yMDgzLVNlbGYtQWRoZXJlbnQvZHAvQjAxN0pUMENYTy8=).** This was a gift from famed performance coach [Jim Loehr](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/92unw45ooanh32805/3wcphk/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuam5qLmNvbS9qamh3cy9qaW0tbG9laHI=), who was featured in [Tribe of Mentors](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/92unw45ooanh32805/nesohv/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9UcmliZS1NZW50b3JzLVNob3J0LUFkdmljZS1Xb3JsZC9kcC8xMzI4OTk0OTYx). He uses this with many of his top athletes, and I also found it infinitely easier to use than ACE bandages and similar alternatives. If latex isn’t an issue for you, other versions of the 3M Coban tape will also do the job.
